name: IN-03
label: Safe R

key_factors: Incumbent Stutzman running with large fundraising edge
No polls or expert ratings; markets price D at ~4%
model.rationale: The R+16 district lean, Stutzman's incumbency and roughly six-to-one fundraising advantage over Thompson leave no evidence pointing toward an upset, and prediction markets price the Democrat near 4%. The forecast stays anchored to the fundamentals with a slight Republican tilt beyond the raw lean.
model.watch: Any credible polling showing Stutzman under 55% or a surge of outside spending against him would warrant a relook.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Northeast Indiana's 3rd District is solidly Republican territory, with a partisan lean of about R+16, and incumbent Marlin Stutzman is running for re-election after easily securing his party's nomination. Stutzman has raised roughly $840,000 and holds a large cash advantage, while Democrat Kelly Thompson has raised about $136,000 with minimal cash on hand and no outside support on either side.

No public polls or expert ratings are available for this race, so the outlook rests on fundamentals. Prediction markets give the Democrat only about a 4% chance of winning. The combination of the district's lean, incumbency, and the financial gap makes this a Safe Republican seat, with low uncertainty about the overall outcome even if the exact margin is hard to pin down.
